summary: HQ / ownership: Costa Mesa, CA; acquired by Toast, Feb 16, 2023 (price undisclosed); 35,000+ locations in 70 countries at acquisition
Drive-thru displays, order-confirmation and menu boards, now part of Toast's QSR/drive-thru push
Bundled with the fastest-growing restaurant POS (Toast, ~180k locations) — the closest analog to Genius's POS+DMB bundle

Toast acquired Delphi in February 2023 and launched Toast Drive-Thru in April 2026 using Delphi expertise. (Scope note: Launch does not establish deployed site count or a separate Delphi commercial offer.)
